label: DBAL Entity Query
code:
-- Query entities from DBAL
local dbal = require("metabuilder.dbal")

local users = dbal.query("core", "users", {
    where = { role = "admin", active = true },
    order_by = "created_at DESC",
    limit = 50
})

for _, user in ipairs(users) do
    print(string.format("[%s] %s (%s)", user.id, user.name, user.role))
end

label: Workflow Trigger
code:
-- Trigger a workflow from Lua
local workflow = require("metabuilder.workflow")

local result = workflow.trigger("on_user_created", {
    tenant_id = ctx.tenant_id,
    user_id = new_user.id,
    email = new_user.email,
    source = "lua_script"
})

if result.success then
    log.info("Workflow dispatched: " .. result.execution_id)
else
    log.error("Workflow failed: " .. result.error)
end

label: JSON Schema Validation
code:
-- Validate data against a JSON schema
local schema = require("metabuilder.schema")

local user_schema = schema.load("entities/user")

local data = {
    name = "demo_user",
    email = "demo@example.com",
    role = "user"
}

local valid, errors = schema.validate(data, user_schema)
if not valid then
    for _, err in ipairs(errors) do
        log.warn("Validation error: " .. err.path .. " - " .. err.message)
    end
end
